intent: A drowned plague bog at night: brown-black mud, dead grey-olive reeds and a dead orchard of brown-black trees, sick-green pools and one bile yellow-green accent, reading olive-grey from the high camera against a pale drowned chapel tower over the wood and a low bile-green miasma drifting between the trunks.
requests: A gibbet kind (a frame with a hanging iron cage): the brief's ring of gibbets needs one, and no existing kind builds it.
A plague-pit kind (a sunken mass grave ringed with stones): the drowned chapel had to stand as the landmark instead.
A sick-green water material or pool sheen that reads at the high camera without looking neon: the pool sculpt's flat glass is the only water the kit offers.
